cases.name: etaf-youtube-check-records-account
cases.purpose: Opening a session asks the skill for the account and records its name and sign-in state.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-home-feed-loads-cards
cases.purpose: The home route loads list items, a title and a pagination cursor into the state.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-load-more-appends-items
cases.purpose: Load-more reads the cursor and appends the next page without replacing the first.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-search-sends-the-selected-filter
cases.purpose: Search sends the query and the selected filter to the skill and shows the search route.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-watch-loads-video-comments-and-source
cases.purpose: Opening a video reads its details, comments and a resolved media source with split audio, headers and proxy.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-stale-feed-reply-is-dropped
cases.purpose: A reply from a route the user has left never replaces the newest list.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-player-commands-update-state
cases.purpose: Seek, speed, volume, mute and quality update the session and re-resolve the source at the new quality.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-captions-follow-the-playback-position
cases.purpose: Turning captions on loads the track's cues and reports the cue covering the current playback position.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-resume-round-trip
cases.purpose: Leaving a watch page records the playback position in the local store and reopening the video restores it.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-writes-need-explicit-confirmation
cases.purpose: A write is previewed without confirmation and submitted only with it, then reported with its certainty.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-comment-submitted-unverified-is-a-warning
cases.purpose: A submitted but unverified comment is shown as a warning and is never retried automatically.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-selection-and-activation
cases.purpose: Selection moves within the list and activation opens the selected video route.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-back-retraces-history
cases.purpose: Back returns to the previous route and reloads its list.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-chips-switch-channel-tabs
cases.purpose: A channel tab chip browses the same channel with its parameters.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-replies-load-per-comment
cases.purpose: Replies load through the comment's own cursor and appear in the reply map.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-theme-sidebar-and-theater
cases.purpose: Appearance and layout choices change the reported state and the palette.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-thumbnails-load-through-the-injected-fetcher
cases.purpose: Requesting a thumbnail stores a descriptor, bumps the version and does not repeat the request.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-view-mounts-with-list-content
cases.purpose: The mounted shell renders the loaded list inside an ETAF buffer.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-destroy-releases-the-session
cases.purpose: Destroy cancels the session and leaves a destroyed model safe to destroy again.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-process-runner-reads-skill-json
cases.purpose: The default process runner drains a real child process and parses its protocol JSON without a browser.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-thumbnails-strip-signed-query
cases.purpose: Signed YouTube thumbnail tokens are dropped before downloading so the CDN serves the decodable JPEG while the cache still keys the original URL.

cases.name: etaf-youtube-thumbnail-disk-cache-survives-reopen
cases.purpose: A cached thumbnail file survives a later session that reuses the same thumbnail directory.
